notes.title: Patch notes 22 November 2024
notes.notes:
- This patch fixed the double right-click error that was found to cause the game to exit with a fatal error.
 - This patch adds a new (6th) achievement.
 - This patch makes the game state file saving more robust, reducing the chances for the game's save state file to be corrupted and reset unexpectedly.

notes.title: Patch notes 10 June 2024
notes.notes: - This patch eliminates redundant achievement logging errors pertaining to the Steam server.

notes.title: Patch notes 08 June 2024
notes.notes: - This patch adds a help button to the primary ant farm window of the game that explicitly provides help documentation for the primary controls of the game. Formerly, this information was available on the store page.

notes.title: Patch notes 07 June 2024
notes.notes:
- This patch adds formatting improvements to the auto-feeder rate that is displayed in the upgrades window. Now, the digits representing the rate in pellets per second will be rounded properly before being displayed to ensure that the upgrade progress is no longer obscured during several of the upgrade purchases.
- This patch also adds additional functionality aimed to proactively remove the known (yet ephemeral issue) mentioned in the game's store page documentation. Specifically, when purchasing new ants, stripe colors, and base colors, this can result in the drop down menus of the respective upgrades window not being updated immediately without requiring a game reboot.
